catalog.name: Tiny brain
catalog.description: About 400 MB, for proving offline thinking runs on this computer without spending gigabytes. It is genuinely small: expect short, shaky answers and tasks it cannot plan. Not a working brain - a way to find out whether the engine starts before committing to one.

catalog.name: Light brain
catalog.description: For computers with 4 GB of memory. The fastest and the least capable.

catalog.name: Standard brain
catalog.description: For everyday laptops with 8 GB of memory or more. Reads screenshots.

catalog.name: Pro brain
catalog.description: Smarter and slower. For computers with 16 GB of memory or a graphics card with 8 GB.
